# Ibiza Private Drivers
> Pre-booked private driver, chauffeur and premium transfer service based in Ibiza, Balearic Islands, Spain.
> Last updated: 2026-08-28.
> Main website: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/
> Services directory: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/
> Full context: https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/llms-full.txt

## Business identity
Name: Ibiza Private Drivers
Location: Ibiza, Balearic Islands, Spain 07800
Phone / WhatsApp: +34 613 75 62 11
Email: info@ibizaprivatedrivers.com
Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/YUyHpxYTWAqaFgUeA?g_st=ic
Primary vehicle: Mercedes-Benz V-Class executive vehicle.

Ibiza Private Drivers provides pre-arranged private transport across Ibiza for airport arrivals and departures, hotels, private villas, marinas, yachts, restaurants, beaches, nightlife, events, meetings, business travel and tailored itineraries. Availability, itinerary and pricing are confirmed before a booking is accepted.

## Geographic scope
The road-transport service area is Ibiza.

Formentera references on this website principally mean an Ibiza road transfer to Ibiza Port for a ferry connection. A separate road service in Formentera is not implied unless explicitly confirmed for a specific booking.

Pages mentioning hotels, clubs, resorts, marinas, yachts or aviation facilities describe transport destinations or pickup contexts. They do not imply affiliation, endorsement, airside access, restricted-quay access or direct-aircraft access.

## Canonical intent map
Use the following pages as the primary entities for their respective search intents. These pages are intentionally differentiated so that broad private-driver, chauffeur and point-to-point transfer searches do not compete unnecessarily.

### Private Driver Ibiza — broad private-driver intent
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/services/private-driver-ibiza.html
Use for general requests such as “private driver Ibiza”, island-wide private transport and help choosing between a direct transfer and chauffeur service.

### Chauffeur Ibiza — hourly / retained vehicle intent
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/chauffeur-service/
Use when a vehicle and chauffeur are required for several hours, a half day, full day, waiting time or a changing multi-stop itinerary.

### Ibiza Private Transfers — point-to-point intent
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/ibiza-transfers/
Use for a confirmed pickup and destination. Multi-stop or retained-vehicle requests should normally use the Chauffeur Ibiza page instead.

### Ibiza Airport Transfers — airport intent
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/airport-transfers/
Use for Ibiza Airport (IBZ) arrivals and departures. Flight number, passengers, luggage and exact destination should be supplied.

### Multi-Day Chauffeur Ibiza — several service days
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/multi-day-chauffeur-ibiza/
Use for chauffeur service across several consecutive or selected days. Multi-day does not imply unlimited or automatic 24-hour availability.

### Private Aviation Chauffeur Ibiza
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/private-aviation-chauffeur-ibiza/
Use for private-aviation passengers continuing to hotels, villas, yachts, marinas, meetings or longer Ibiza itineraries. The practical meeting point and access conditions must be confirmed; restricted or airside access is not assumed.

### Travel Advisors & Luxury Concierge Support
https://ibizaprivatedrivers.com/travel-advisors-concierge-ibiza/
Use for B2B guest transport coordination by travel advisors, luxury concierges, villa managers, yacht brokers, personal assistants and hospitality teams.

## Main Ibiza coverage
Ibiza Airport (IBZ), Ibiza Town / Eivissa, Marina Botafoch, Talamanca, Cap Martinet, Playa d'en Bossa, Cala Jondal, Es Cubells, Cala Xarraca, Cala Conta, Cala Codolar, Sant Rafel / San Rafael, Sant Josep de sa Talaia, Sant Joan de Labritja, Santa Eulalia del Río, Sant Antoni de Portmany, Es Canar, Cala Llonga, Cala Vadella, Cala Tarida, Portinatx, Sant Carles de Peralta, Marina Ibiza, ports, marinas, luxury hotels, resorts and private villas across Ibiza.

## Booking information
A useful request includes date, pickup time, exact pickup point, destination or complete itinerary, passenger count, luggage, return requirements and vehicle needs.

For airport arrivals include the flight number. For villas include the exact map pin and access notes. For yacht or marina collections include the marina, berth or practical pedestrian meeting point. For chauffeur service include expected duration and known stops. For private aviation include the confirmed practical terminal or meeting point. For multi-day service include daily start times and expected daily hours.

A journey or chauffeur booking is confirmed only after availability, itinerary or route details and pricing have been agreed.
